Absolute http(s) URL, no credentials, query or fragment; requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR; invalid value refuses to start. Never requested by the server.

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.

environmentVariables.description: Optional operator font sandbox: absolute path of a directory of .ttf / .otf files (at most 64, 16 MiB each), each parsed by the engine and registered at boot under the slug of its file name; tools name one with the font input (FONT_NOT_FOUND otherwise). An invalid directory or file refuses to start. Never a path from a tool argument.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_FONT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE

environmentVariables.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH

environmentVariables.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS

server.name: io.github.Nizoka/pkinative-mcp
server.description: PKI MCP server: inspect, verify, issue, sign X.509, CSR, CRL, OCSP, CMS, TSP, PKCS#12. 34 tools
server.title: pkinative MCP — X.509, CMS, OCSP, time-stamps and PKCS#12 without a key byte leaving

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: path inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Key-bearing files (.key .p8 .p12 .pfx) are read by the key tools only, never written, never served as resources. Unset: every tool works on inline PEM / base64 only.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches path inputs, file output, a call carrying a password or a signer, a clock-dependent instant, a random serial or nonce, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless PKINATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Operator-side password of the encrypted PKCS#8 key or PKCS#12 file the tools open (keeps the secret out of the model transcript). Exclusive with the per-call password input (both at once is VALIDATION_ERROR). Never logged; only its presence is reported at startup.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Pinned instant (ISO 8601 or epoch milliseconds) every omitted at / notBefore / signingTime falls back to, for reproducible verdicts and artefacts. Unset: the wall clock (a clock-dependent result is never cached). An invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_AT

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxInputBytes and the decoded size of one PKI object (default 67108864 = 64 MiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxKdfIterations and limits.maxPkcs12KdfIterations (default 10000000, the engine default): the CPU bound of a hostile PBES2 key or PKCS#12 file. Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxPathsExplored (default 1000, the engine default): the RFC 5280 section 6 path-building work bound. Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize, limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize and limits.maxEntryCompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for every file written in outputMode='file' (create_zip, modify_zip, canonicalize_zip, merge_zip, extract_zip, inflate_raw), enforced while streaming (default 4294967296 = 4 GiB, the 1.0.0 behaviour).
